items.reason: Detail `s` uses the same Status menu builder with the detail container.
Detail `y` opens the container’s Copy menu without copying.
Detail `m` opens the container’s Mute menu.
Both views use the same container `I` handler.
Direct `y` and `p` handling is removed from document peeks.
Direct `p` handling is removed from both detail lists.
Item and artifact Run menu handling remains unchanged.
An existing detail flash takes priority over the new status refusal and hides it until that flash expires.
An existing detail flash can also hide the new copy or mute refusal.
Container menus use the detail frame’s reserved Block and body height calculation.
Detail menus use the existing menu navigation and verb dispatch.
Escape clears the menu and preserves the detail.
Detail menu openers bypass Selection handling and create singular menus.
Search narrows both detail lists; Enter restores normal detail key handling.
Search uses case-insensitive substrings across id, title and type, with terms AND-ed.
Item status is excluded from search fields.
Artifact search uses the same grammar over name and type.
Escape discards the buffer and restores the applied term.
Search opens with an empty buffer; applying it clears the query.
Printable keys, including `j`, `k`, `v` and `r`, go to the search field.
Detail refresh applies the current query, and the header shows the applied term.
Empty search results name the query and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability uses the full collection, so filtering preserves the view switch.
Detail search state is separate and is discarded when the detail closes.
Detail hints name the required menus and search; peek hints remove direct copy keys.
Search typing hints name only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help lists the required menus, container verb, search and conditional clear entry; peek copy shortcuts are removed.
Help handles detail search separately and adjusts menu help for detail use.

scores.rationale: Shared handlers and focused tests support maintainability; flash priority is incorrect, and menu dispatch and layout tests are incomplete.
